system.description: A particular enemy, or even a group of powerful enemies, is out to ruin you or to kill you. The Flaw's value reflects the enemy's power: a single vampire of roughly your own strength is worth one Trait, while a cabal of mages or an entire hunter organization is worth five. The Storyteller weaves your enemy into ongoing plots; he may not appear every game, but his machinations will.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
